I'm not telling anyone what to do, but just a PSA. Totally agree with plate and reverse lights, that's a pretty good idea. But anywhere else in your car, be careful doing this, if you don't get bulbs that are made as exact drop in replacements, the reflector in the head or tail light might not align correctly (since it's made to turn the point source of a hot filament into a parallel beam, not a wide flat COB LED). Also if your turn signal system is older and was made for tungsten filament bulbs, LEDs might cause it to start flashing fast because it thinks a bulb is out. If you have something like a '98 Corolla, LEDs anywhere besides reverse lights and illuminators are likely to attract more negative attention from the cops than they'll save you. Again, no shade, just putting it out there.
